title: Distinct Numbers In Each Subarray
description:
Given an integer array `nums` and a window size `k`, return the number of distinct values in every contiguous subarray of length `k`. Results are ordered by increasing starting index.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,2,3,2,2,1,3], k = 3
Output: [3,2,2,2,3]
```

```text
Input: nums = [1,1,1,1,2,3,4], k = 4
Output: [1,2,3,4]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= k <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5`
